$comment: Exceptions for pnpm brand:check (scripts/brandCheck.ts). Only exact identifiers (a trailing * matches an identifier prefix; optional "paths" scopes an identifier to files) or path globs, each with a reason. Reviewed by boss-mobile-security. Rules: docs/contrib/upstream-merges.md.

identifiers.reason: Service name of the CherryIN model service this app consumes (PD-6: service names stay unchanged).
Service name of the CherryAI service this app consumes (PD-6: service names stay unchanged).
i18n key names (common.cherryStudio, common.cherryStudioDescription) referenced from values through $t() nesting; keys are identifiers, their values carry the name.
Bonjour service type the desktop advertises for pairing (app.json NSBonjourServices); a wire contract (PD-5), not display text.
File-name prefix that selects the share-extension sources (CherryShareExtension, CherryShareViewController, CherryStrings); PD-5 native target names.
Remote-protocol wire discriminant shared with the-boss desktop's QR pairing schema (PD-5); renaming breaks the pairing contract.

Analytics channel id for upstream Cherry's analytics backend (iOS listing); never sent because ANALYTICS_REPORTING_DISABLED is true. Kept verbatim for clean upstream merges; replace it in the same change that lands the first-party analytics endpoint.

Analytics channel id for upstream Cherry's analytics backend (Android listing); never sent because ANALYTICS_REPORTING_DISABLED is true. Kept verbatim for clean upstream merges; replace it in the same change that lands the first-party analytics endpoint.

Upstream Cherry Studio's AMD Radeon Cloud attribution value: the token-factory link query (source=cherry-studio) and the X-Source header forced on every radeon-cloud request. Outbound to AMD, never displayed; it attributes this app's Radeon traffic to upstream (operator decision pending). Provider endpoints take upstream's (docs/contrib/upstream-merges.md).
Provenance link to the upstream CherryHQ/cherry-studio desktop's raw provider-registry catalog (PD-5); identifies where the synced data comes from, not our brand.

Upstream's GitCode repository (CherryHQ/cherry-studio-app), the publish target of this script; the fork does not own it, and publishing is refused unless BOSS_ALLOW_GITCODE_PUBLISH=1. Kept for clean upstream merges; a repository slug, not user-visible copy.

Detection value asserting the synced upstream desktop checkout still declares its historical package name; a historical value used for detection is input, not identity (docs/contrib/upstream-merges.md #Values-That-Are-NOT-Branding).

Nitro native-module identifier baked into generated load-library and log strings (PD-5: Nitro CherryStudioUI target name); regenerated by `pnpm --filter @cherrystudio/ui native:codegen`, never hand-edited.

paths.reason: Tests and fixtures assert historical and upstream values on purpose; they are not shipped copy.
Storybook fixtures are development-only and never shipped.
Developer tool that reads the upstream CherryHQ/cherry-studio desktop checkout; its messages name that upstream product (provenance, not our brand).
